steps.name: probe div
steps.expr:
const p=document.createElement('div'); p.id='probe'; document.querySelector('main').appendChild(p); window.PROBE=(k,s)=>{const n=document.querySelector(s); p.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','
'+(n?n.innerHTML:'MISSING')+'
');}; return 'ok'

steps.name: tok
steps.expr: const i=document.getElementById('tok-input'); i.value='Hello, world! It is 5pm.'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); PROBE('tok','#tok-out'); return 'ok'

steps.name: tfidf stages
steps.expr: for (const b of document.querElementsAll ? [] : document.querySelectorAll('#tfidf-stages button')) { b.click(); PROBE('cap-'+b.dataset.stage,'#tfidf-caption'); } PROBE('tfidf-note-default','#tfidf-note'); const t=document.getElementById('toy-input'); t.value='foo bar\nbaz qux'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); PROBE('tfidf-note-edit','#tfidf-note'); return 'ok'

steps.name: guess
steps.expr: document.querySelectorAll('#guess-cols select').forEach(s=>{s.value='0'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}); document.getElementById('btn-guess-reveal').click(); PROBE('guess-reveal','#guess-note'); document.getElementById('btn-guess-reset').click(); PROBE('guess-reset','#guess-note'); return 'ok'

steps.name: analogy
steps.expr: const a=document.getElementById('an-a'); const v0=a.value; a.value='zzzzqq'; a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); PROBE('an-missing','#an-out'); a.value=v0; a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); document.getElementById('btn-excl').click(); PROBE('an-excl','#an-out'); document.getElementById('btn-noexcl').click(); PROBE('an-noexcl','#an-out'); return 'ok'
